title: The Political Calendar Is Moving Faster Than the Guardrails.
method: AI-assisted cross-source synthesis with direct links to originating publishers. Reviewed against a five-item gate including two primary institutional sources.

items.headline: South Sudan dissolves its transitional government ahead of a delayed election
items.whyItMatters: Removing constitutional and census prerequisites accelerates the timetable while leaving voter registration and institutional safeguards unresolved.

items.headline: Tigrayan forces reportedly seize Mekelle airport as regional flights stop
items.whyItMatters: Control of transport infrastructure and suspended civilian flights indicate a material escalation around the fragile Pretoria peace framework.

items.headline: United States reportedly links Sudanese army chief's UN visa to a ceasefire plan
items.whyItMatters: Visa leverage has become part of ceasefire diplomacy, but the State Department did not confirm the reported condition and the dispute may harden positions.

items.headline: EAC and IGAD coordinate regional digital integration programmes
items.whyItMatters: Cross-border broadband, compatible regulation and shared digital skills are the institutional layer needed to turn national projects into a regional market.

items.headline: EAC trains 120 frontline health professionals for high-consequence outbreaks
items.whyItMatters: Regional preparedness depends on a reusable clinical training network, not only emergency mobilization after an outbreak begins.
